svg.title: Eventra relational entity-relationship diagram
svg.desc: Pastel-colored entity cards showing the nine tables in Eventra's MySQL schema and their foreign-key relationships.
svg.text: Nine entities · Foreign-key relationships shown as 1:N · Pastel key badges identify PK, FK and UQ

g.text: NULL = nullable column · 1:N = one-to-many relationship · Notices has no declared foreign keys
